name: Case law: Netherlands, the rechtbanken (district courts): zeeland west brabant
label: Netherlands case law (the rechtbanken (district courts): zeeland west brabant)
coverage: 47070 published decisions with text (uitspraken and conclusies), one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 2244 citations of law linked to netherlands-law.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Decisions the courts publish only as metadata (no text) are not included. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day.
